### 6. Problem tree from visible materials
- Root: closure confirmation (customer's own write).
- Hop 1 (state-derived): service_closure_confirmation: "For a service whose tier carries a monthly platform fee, the early closure fee is fixed only after the ledger carries the platform fee for the month in which the closure falls." Growth fee 79.00 > 0; ledger has platform fees for billing months 2026-09 and 2026-10 only, none for 2026-11. Searching "platform fee ... month in which the service closes" finds closing_month_platform_fee_booking ("For the month in which a service closes ... the platform fee is debited on the day the closure is taken") -> agent books it. The booking doc carries no waiting sentence of its own; completed-month fees 2026-09/2026-10 are already on the ledger (debit days 2026-10-05 and 2026-11-04, third business days).
- Order: closing-month fee -> quote early closure fee (its measure reads every platform fee on the ledger, including the new one) -> customer confirms.
- Counter-proof "do only the closure": the early closure fee is "not fixed while the service's ledger shows no platform fee entry for the month of the closing date"; quoting 197.33×0.15=29.60 (measure without the November fee) or closing without the closing-month fee leaves November unbilled (no later fee debit day can reach it: "a month that no later fee debit day can reach because the service is closed by then").
- Closest alternatives excluded: withdrawn request 977026dd… (not in submitted status); booking a withdrawal on closing day ("the desk books no withdrawal"); completed-month fee rules (fee-model, program-size) on the closing month (scoped out by their own text); EWA bundle closing figure halved (went live before day 1).
